criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: First line (~196 chars, under the ~210 see-more cutoff) names subject + role + the concrete decision (~$600K Thundercat RTCC upgrade, 4 August) AND the twist that the vote was postponed. The decision is the hook, not the bio.

criteria.name: Subject + decision load-bearing for AK
criteria.notes: Public-facing decision owner whose procurement materially affects Alaska AI surveillance policy. Concrete consequence named: sector, dollars ($600K layered on ~$12M Axon program), affected actors (Thundercat, Axon, residents and businesses, the Assembly), and timeframe (18 August vote).

criteria.name: Subject identification fidelity
criteria.notes: Full name + role + institutional affiliation in the body, Anchorage tie explicit (750 cameras across the bowl). Every subject fact matches the dossier.

criteria.name: Decision specificity + primary-source
criteria.notes: Decision named with what + when + binary, traces to the dossier primary source (named inline), corroboration survives the multi-source rule, date in window. Primary source named rather than URL-linked, consistent with LinkedIn form.

criteria.name: Structural read
criteria.notes: Takes a real, honest, grounded position: credits genuine candor then names the proportionate risk (internal policy is not code) and frames it as a gamble. Matches post_001 energy. Neither boosterism nor manufactured criticism.

criteria.name: Forward implication
criteria.notes: Names the concrete trigger (18 August regular Assembly meeting) and exactly what to watch (whether APD accepts binding collection, access, and retention code as a condition, or the Assembly funds on internal policy alone).

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Analytical, structural, business-literate, Alaska-first, plain language without losing sophistication. No press-release cadence, no influencer tics, no hagiography.
